# counter_sponge — repaired realism QA

Evidence: f0008, f3666, f3684. Calibrations and source images are retained in ../measurements.json and ../evidence/.

- Added sampled long edges for the hourglass waist and fitted size/pose in three views; replaced baked patch colour with porous subsurface yellow foam.
- Baked foam albedo and pore normals to portable PBR textures, fixing white foam in the GLB export; added diffuse room fill to reduce clipped highlights.
- Replaced bounding box with 12 narrow waist-following collision sections.
- Declared deformable foam parameters and retained an explicit rigid fallback.

Yellow hourglass foam on a green abrasive layer; three-view fitted size [0.09266790002584457, 0.05457989498972893, 0.025037208572030067]. The earlier 0.1204 x 0.0663 m depth rectangle and 0.985 m landing assumption are retained as historical measurements, superseded by multi-view visual fitting. Round 2 pose and dimensions were re-fitted from three fixed calibrated views with support height constrained to the current cabinetry countertop at 1.005 m. Hidden details and material parameters remain estimated.

Physics: Dry bulk foam plus denser abrasive layer; wet mass changes, density is effective bulk, not polymer density. Mass 0.015 kg, friction 0.5, restitution 0.03. All are estimates, not measured product values. See model.json physics for COM, density and material model.

Deformable behavior is required; tentative parameters are declared. The exported Blender runtime still uses the rigid proxy until a simulator soft-body adapter is supplied.

No manipulation was observed. Joints and ranges remain unverified assumptions. See ../qa_report.json and ../qa_summary.md for measured comparisons and outstanding limitations.

## Round 2

Source-pose grades: silhouette B, proportions A, color_texture B, articulation B, physics B, collision B, instances B. Mean silhouette IoU 0.818.

- Round 2: re-measured source depth/planes in f0008, f3666, f3684; refitted pose, yaw and dimensions with 1.005 m contact constraint from current cabinetry.
- Round 2: generated photo-referenced open-cell foam albedo, calibrated hue/lighting and rebaked portable PBR colour/normal textures.

Remaining: Deformable material parameters declared; actual soft-body solver integration remains unimplemented. Mass, friction and centre of mass are estimates; real product weight unavailable. Photo scores apply to the source-fit pose on the retained 1.005 m support. supported.xml uses the distinct contact-seated pose on the current tilted cabinet; that adjusted pose is not certified by these photo scores.
